name: Russia
description: Strategic nuclear standoff bomber triad (Tu-160M, Tu-95MS), heavy supermaneuverable Flanker derivatives (Su-35S, Su-30SM2, Su-34M), 5th-generation Su-57 Felon, and advanced long-range hypersonic missiles (R-37M, Kinzhal).

militaryBranches.name: Russian Aerospace Forces
militaryBranches.description: Frontline fighter-bombers (Su-57, Su-35S, Su-34M), long-range strategic bombers (Tu-160M), and attack helicopters (Ka-52M, Mi-28NM).

militaryBranches.name: Russian Naval Aviation
militaryBranches.description: Maritime strike (Su-30SM2), carrier aviation (MiG-29K), and anti-submarine warfare (Il-38N Sea Dragon, Ka-27PL).

sources.name: World Bank MS.MIL.TOTL.P1 / IISS Armed Forces Series
